By the time of the [[Third Galactic War]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> this '''armor''' was a [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] utilized by [[Ri'kan Kateen]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who served as a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] of the [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="CM" />

{{Stub}}
